summary: Leclerc and Ferrari hunt momentum against a resurgent Antonelli, who sits on the championship precipice and promises to attack with freedom this weekend in Austin. Verstappen's complaints about the track's treacherous bumps could shuffle the grid advantage, testing which team best adapts their setup to the deteriorating surface. A dominant Antonelli performance would seal the title ahead of schedule, while a Ferrari victory could tighten the standings and inject chaos into the final races.
